arms.candidate_only_change: Both candidate arms use Unit leaf evaluation, Unit normal capture ordering, Unit promotion ordering, same legal actions and qsearch settings. Only inside the existing _order_qactions call, candidate capture_order_value is Unit versus static-v2. This test-only proxy is not a product API and does not change production code.
arms.fixed_foe: Unit leaf, Unit normal move ordering and Unit qsearch ordering in both arms.
arms.physical_games: 8 rules x 2 roots x 2 candidate owners x 2 candidate arms = 64

changed_premise: Existing default and staged capture/promotion price panels used qdepth=0. The actual optional qsearch path calls _order_qactions -> MoveOrderer.order -> Evaluator.capture_order_value. A one-root outcome-free probe verified the qsearch-only proxy reaches this hook while normal capture-order calls remain Unit in both arms. This does not establish utility.

cost.basis: Prior matched 64-game q0 panels completed in roughly 223-247 seconds; qdepth2 adds capped qsearch work. Per-search cap is 0.5s and 128 qnodes, one fixed 64-slot panel, plus replay/audit. Estimate is below 120 minutes.
cost.cheaper_alternative: Stop after outcome-free preflight and close as untested if fewer than 8 of 16 roots trigger qsearch capture ordering or estimated full-panel runtime exceeds 3600 seconds.

integrity: Freeze plan before outcomes. Record all 64 slots once; no outcome-based root filtering, seed replacement, cap extension or rerun.
Preserve promotion, drops, hands, auxiliary state, repetition, and full histories; validate action legality and replay each full record.
Keep UNKNOWN, cancellation, terminal, incomplete and cap outcomes distinct.
No training, no solver, no product/default source changes and no other role checkout/state access.

pre_outcome_execution_amendment.qsearch_intervention: A test-only wrapper around the production _order_qactions call temporarily substitutes the candidate q-order evaluator, then restores the Unit main evaluator before recursion; the wrapper never changes main-search MoveOrderer calls or leaf evaluation.
pre_outcome_execution_amendment.reason: The frozen matched-game runner requires an explicit candidate-ply horizon; omitted from the initial pre-outcome plan. No outcomes existed when amended.

question: On fresh generated 5x5 roots, does changing only the candidate's qsearch capture ordering from Unit to static-v2 alter conservative finite-budget utility or robust node cost, with normal ordering and Unit leaf values fixed?

retention.retain_sampled_route_if: Either conservative reward lower bounds are strictly positive in every listed view, or median paired candidate-node reduction is at least 10% overall and in both owners and both parities while no corresponding conservative reward lower bound is negative. Otherwise close this sampled qsearch candidate.
retention.reward: Compare candidate qsearch price against Unit qsearch price on exact matched root/owner with the same fixed Unit foe. Every unresolved/UNKNOWN pair contributes independently [-1,+1] before conservative subtraction; never impute.
retention.scope: No product/default/global price change, no population/strength claim, no rerun/top-up or favorable subgroup selection.

roots.selection: Use every generated rule and both prescribed roots. Do not select/filter/replace based on action exposure, qsearch calls, profile, outcomes, cap use or cost. Preserve terminal-before-search or no-hook roots as such; no top-up.
